propositions: Five prose upgrades target escape classes: parity census at build time, config read-but-miswired semantics, op-level contention triggers, gate findings without oracle upgrades, and known gaps at close

Surface-parity census must enumerate five slots (CLI, MCP-API, library-facade, automated-callers, dual-direction) with explicit in-scope-proven or out-of-scope-reason disposition for changes touching parallel surfaces
Config-effect contrast tests must prove each config key changes behavior through the real read path via default vs non-default comparison, not just value parsing

Op-level contention cases must route by shape to existing shared suites: composed/check-then-act writes to two_clones fixture, write-storm/retry to storm suite, read-integrity to reads-under-sync-contention harness
Behavioral gate findings require RED test first then fix; non-behavioral findings fixed directly with exemption stated to prevent change-detector tests
Residual-gap disposition sweep enumerates out-of-scope slots and exclusions, filing each item as ticket+source, accepted-with-reason, or fixed
